import os,json
from pathlib import Path
config=json.load(open('/run/pandamonium/config.json'))
Path('/runtime/board/barehands.json').write_text(json.dumps({'name':'Pandamonium board','port':int(config['PANDAMONIUM_PORT'])}))
os.execv('/usr/bin/python3',['python3','/runtime/board/server.py'])

import json,sys,urllib.request
config=json.load(open('/run/pandamonium/config.json'))
route='/state' if sys.argv[1]=='barehands__board_state' else '/config'
with urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:'+config['PANDAMONIUM_PORT']+route,timeout=10) as response: data=json.load(response)
print(json.dumps({'connected':bool(data),'state_json':json.dumps(data)} if route=='/state' else {'configuration_json':json.dumps(data)}))
